description: Inventory of EduPage website features (what a logged-in user can see/do on the site) mapped to upstream edupage-api support and MCP tool coverage. Anything with status 'partial' or 'missing' is the backlog for the in-repo site-feature layer. This is a design/coverage manifest, not a scraping layer: keep the server a thin wrapper around edupage-api plus the documented feature-layer modules.
roles_note: Role availability per app is approximate; some apps are school-configured and may be hidden by the school admin.

apps.label: Login / 2FA / multi-school
apps.status_reason: Library plus wrapper cover portal login, 2FA device confirmation, and per-subdomain sessions.

apps.label: Parent -> student account switching and discovery
apps.status_reason: Role-aware switching, tiered name matching, and per-student timetable lookup are implemented.

apps.label: Timetable (daily / range / next week / per-student)
apps.status_reason: Full timetable surface is exposed; note get_timetable/get_student_timetable occasionally raise UnknownServerError on some accounts.
next_steps: Investigate UnknownServerError('NoneType' object has no attribute 'get') seen for iprskola.

apps.label: Substitutions/timetable changes and missing teachers
apps.status_reason: Daily changes and missing-teacher list are exposed.

apps.label: Canteen menu (read + ordering)
apps.status_reason: Reading the menu is now covered for both per-student ordering schools and schools that only expose the public canteen widget (menu_CanteenMenu_1 fallback). Ordering (choose/sign-off/rate) still requires the school's ordering module; iprskola is read-only via the widget.
next_steps: None for read. Ordering stays blocked until a school with the ordering module is validated, or the widget exposes order actions.

apps.label: Messages (send + read inbox)
apps.status_reason: Sending works; reading the inbox is only surfaced indirectly through timeline notifications (get_notifications/get_notification_history). There is no full message-thread listing.
next_steps: Feature-layer module to list/summarize message threads from the communication app.

apps.label: Cloud / file upload
apps.status_reason: Upstream exposes only upload (and it is currently ignored by the coverage check, not exposed as an MCP tool). No file listing/download.
next_steps: Feature-layer module for cloud file listing/download if demand appears.

apps.label: Calendar (school/personal events calendar)
apps.status_reason: Upcoming events come from the timeline feed; the rich calendar app is not covered.
next_steps: Feature-layer module to read the calendar grid.
